source_of_truth: Authored for this benchmark. Every vulnerable sample contains exactly the labeled flaw(s), verified against the analyzer output during development; all credentials in samples are fake fixture values. clean/ contains the safe counterpart of each pattern (parameterized queries, escaped output, quoted commands, allowlisted requests, env-sourced secrets, data-only deserialization).

sql_injection/sqli_php_pdo_02.php.note: PDO::query with interpolated input (prepare not used).

sql_injection/sqli_js_sequelize_04.js.note: template literal into sequelize.query (Juice Shop search shape).

sql_injection/sqli_js_nosql_05.js.note: request value as a Mongo filter value (operator injection).

xss/xss_py_05.py.note: flask Markup of a request parameter.

xss/xss_java_writer_06.java.note: servlet writer prints request parameter unescaped.

command_injection/cmdi_php_01.php.note: shell_exec('ping ' . $target); the command output (containing the attacker string) is echoed into HTML — both classes genuinely present.

command_injection/cmdi_java_04.java.note: Runtime.exec with a concatenated command string.

path_traversal/path_php_readfile_02.php.note: readfile of a joined request path.

path_traversal/path_java_file_05.java.note: new File(base + user + ext) then Files.readAllBytes.

hardcoded_secrets/secret_js_01.js.note: API key literal in client config (fake value).

hardcoded_secrets/secret_php_04.php.note: payment processor keys with define() (fake values).

hardcoded_secrets/secret_go_05.go.note: embedded RSA private key block (fake value).

ssrf/ssrf_js_fetch_01.js.note: server-side fetch of req.body.imageUrl without allowlist (Juice Shop shape).

clean/clean_py_01.py.note: parameterized execute, arg-list subprocess, json.loads, env secret.

clean/clean_py_02.py.note: safe yaml loader, allowlisted request, send_from_directory.

clean/clean_js_01.js.note: parameterized pg, textContent/DOMPurify, execFile, literal URL, env secret.

clean/clean_java_01.java.note: PreparedStatement, normalize+startsWith containment, escaped servlet output.

clean/clean_go_01.go.note: parameterized query, argument-list exec, env secret.
